detector_plain: Alert when the compressor stays loaded (COMP == 0) continuously and the 5-minute maximum loaded-run length stays above the unit-calibrated threshold for 12 consecutive 5-minute bins (about one hour).
development_source: MetroPT-3 (UCI 791); all four air-leak reports used for development

recipe.threshold_rule: lowest threshold whose merged alerts in the calibration window are <= 1 per 7 days
recipe.merge_rule: an alert episode ends once flags stop for more than 30 minutes

target: merged alert in [reported start - 120 min, reported end - 120 min] (Veloso et al. 2022 protocol plus the operator's two-hour removal need)

promotion_gates_external.air_leaks_caught_in_time: >= 2 of the external air leaks scored after calibration
promotion_gates_external.beats_existing_lps_alarm_on_air_leaks: more air leaks caught in time, or equal with >= 30 min more median margin before end

reported_not_gating: oil leaks caught in time (different failure mechanism)
transferred MetroPT-3 threshold of 2.15 instead of per-unit calibration
rules: No recipe, threshold rule, gate or window may change after external data is loaded.
Events that fall before a unit's calibration end are excluded and listed.
If any gate fails, the status is NO_PROMOTION and is reported as such.
